notes.subject: רביו
notes.rationale: 'ol man bilong sutim sena' (archers) o 'ol man bilong pait' — nem i tok long sena tasol, tasol sampela i tanim olsem 'ol birua'.

notes.subject: כליותי
notes.rationale: Hibru i tok long klaut — ples bilong tingting bilong ol man bipo; Tok Pisin i save tok long bel bilong tingting.

notes.subject: מררתי
notes.rationale: מררה (bil) i wankain rod wantaim 'bitter' — bil bilong bodi na trakaiman bilong sori i kamap wanpela tok.

translation: Ol man bilong sutim sena i sanap raun long mi; em i sutim bruk klaut bilong mi, na em i no gat sori; em i skrautim bikpela bil bilong mi i go daun long graun.
